author: WaywardSon78
quote: The game is beautiful and the environment is great…. When you don’t move. The fps is horrible and almost unplayable at times. There are plenty of glitches which hasn’t been game breaking but for a $100 I expected better. The story and characters is the weakest link and I came for the story. This is not the GTA I grew up with. So why a 1? Because the gaming journalists are playing that game so fight fire with fire.

author: WaywardSon78
quote: This game is more than jiggle physics. The gameplay is tight as the protagonist’s leggings. The enemies are varied and very creepy. The story and characters are mid but I’m not here for that. I’m here to slice and dice and this game satisfies that itch. Doesn’t hurt that Eve is pleasing to the eyes.
